# What do we need to implement this?

## Before skynet

- **Funding.** Several goes at grants of a few million, and a lot of
  scepticism about Julia. None of them funded so far
- **A team.** A few people
- **Buy-in.** Other groups have to want to build on it. Otherwise it is one
  more package that only we use

::: {.attribution}
"We have been applying for funding to do it. So far without success", the
EpiAware announcement post, `news/posts/hello-epiaware.qmd` on
[epiaware.org](https://epiaware.org), published 2026-07-10, read
2026-08-12.
:::
